name: Erich Weissach
original_name: エーリッヒ ヴァイスザッハ
source:
A Prussian soldier and one of the second generation superhumans created in the experiment "Valkyrie Plan".

Based on Erich Alfred Hartmann, also known as the Black Devil, who was a German fighter pilot during World War II and the most successful fighter ace in the history of aerial warfare. He was born in Weissach.
